_comment: Glossary for consistent naming across a chapter. Fill this in BEFORE translating, and reuse it for every chapter of the same series. Inconsistent character names is the single most common quality failure in comic translation.

titles_and_honorifics._comment: Court/historical manhwa lives or dies on these. Pick one rendering per term and never vary it.

terms._comment: Techniques, factions, magic systems, in-world jargon.

do_not_translate: _comment: names/logos/SFX to leave in the original script
style_notes: Register: spoken and natural, not literary. Manhwa dialogue is conversation.
Persian runs 15-25% longer than English — tighten rather than relying on autosizing.
Keep second-person forms consistent per character relationship (تو vs شما).
Sound effects baked into artwork are usually left as-is.
